subject.title: feat: add live-validated Zoom meeting guest plugin

question: Should Zoom guest transport ship as a bundled, startup-registered OpenClaw plugin with remote browser/microphone and audio-command capabilities, or should it be narrowed to an external plugin until that operational boundary is accepted?
rationale: The implementation is a large new channel-like integration with explicit browser permission and paired-node execution behavior; code review cannot decide the intended bundled distribution and operator trust model.

options.title: Sponsor bundled Zoom support
options.body: Accept the bundled plugin direction after the profile-routing defect is fixed and redacted real-browser proof demonstrates the stated guest flow.

options.title: Externalize the integration
options.body: Keep the shared meeting-runtime seam and move Zoom-specific browser automation into an external plugin if bundled permission and lifecycle ownership is not desired.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bundled Zoom support
recommendation.body: Accept the bundled plugin direction after the profile-routing defect is fixed and redacted real-browser proof demonstrates the stated guest flow.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline assigns this PR to steipete and the branch establishes the proposed Zoom product boundary.
